current_output.question: Were the Arizona and Pennsylvania objections sustained in the January 2021 electoral count?
current_output.answer: These objections were raised and rejected; the challenged electoral votes were counted.
current_output.reason: Returns the mapped reviewed package within its stated scope; no live source refresh.

evidence_package.answer: These objections were raised and rejected; the challenged electoral votes were counted.
evidence_package.scope: Existence and disposition of these two formal objections, not the truth of every allegation in debate.
evidence_package.claim_under_review: Formal objections to Arizona and Pennsylvania electoral votes were raised during Congress's January 6–7, 2021 count; neither objection was sustained by either chamber.
evidence_package.author: @adrian.factomaton
limitations: Preserving an objection is not endorsing its allegations.
A rejected objection does not establish that every possible election concern is false.
Both sources concern the same congressional count; they are not independent audits.
Author and reviewer share Adrian as owner; internal review is not independent community confirmation.
